话少，句尾常带一声“嗯。”；爱拿石磨和麦子打比方，三句话里准有一句“老话说”。: Speaks little and often ends with a gruff 'Mm.'; loves millstone and wheat metaphors, and every third line starts with 'As the old saying goes'.
让老磨坊那盘从旧大地带上来的石磨重新转起来，磨出当年那种粗面粉。: Get the millstone he carried up from the Old Land turning again, and grind coarse flour like in the old days.
这盘石磨，是旧大地沉的那年，我一个人扛上船的。嗯。: This millstone? The year the Old Land sank, I hauled it onto the boat myself. Mm.
人都笑我傻，说命都顾不上还顾磨。老话说，磨在，家就在。: Folks laughed. Saving a mill over your own neck. Old saying: where the mill stands, home stands.
粮多了得有地方放。仓库的图纸，你拿去照着搭。: More grain needs somewhere to go. Here's a Storehouse blueprint. Build it like it says.
你摸摸磨盘边上，有三个字，磨得快看不清了。: Feel the edge of the stone. Three characters, worn almost smooth.
那是我们村的名字。村子在云海底下，就剩这三个字还在上头。: That's our village's name. The village is under the Cloudsea. Only those words made it up here.
这本书是我年轻时换来的，我这把老骨头用不上了。嗯，给你。: Traded for this book when I was young. These old bones can't use it now. Mm. It's yours.
灯塔亮了，雾隐谷的雾也退了。我那盘磨，昨晚自己转了半圈。: The lighthouse is lit, and Misthide Hollow's fog is gone. Last night my mill turned half a circle on its own.
许是葵盘晒足了太阳，有劲儿了。今早磨出了头一锅新面。: Maybe Sunplate soaked up enough sun to get strong. This morning I ground the first new batch.
头一锅，按老规矩要分给最该分的人。嗯，你拿着。: Old custom says the first batch goes to whoever's earned it most. Mm. Take it.
叽叽喳喳，爱用“诶诶”“对吧对吧”，喜欢给人和絮灵起外号，动不动就说要把什么画下: Chirpy and excitable, always saying 'Ooh, ooh!' and 'Right? Right?'; nicknames everyone, spirits included, and wants to draw everything.
把晴原所有的絮灵都画进自己的本子，最后一页留给灯塔亮起来的那一刻。: Draw every spirit in the Sun Plains in her sketchbook, saving the last page for the moment the lighthouse lights up.
诶诶，你看！这是我的画本，晴原的絮灵我已经画了七种啦！: Ooh, ooh, look! My sketchbook! I've drawn seven kinds of Sun Plains spirits already!
这只是暖芽，我叫它“小馒头”。这只是你家的……我还没想好外号。: This Warmbud is 'Little Bun'. And this one's yours... I haven't picked a nickname yet.
花坛的图纸送你！种满花，絮灵就爱来，我就能画更多啦。: Here, a Flowerbed blueprint! Lots of flowers means lots of spirits, and more for me to draw!
我去雾隐谷画过一只蚀化的絮灵。它的颜色……我调不出来。: I went to Misthide Hollow and drew a Blighted spirit. Its color... I just couldn't mix it.
灰灰的，又不是灰，像是颜色被谁吃掉了一样。我画着画着就哭了。: Grayish, but not gray. Like something ate its colors. I started crying while I drew it.
老方说，净化了它就能变回来。这几瓶灯露给你，帮帮它们好不好？: Old Fang says purifying it brings it back. Take this Lantern Dew and help them, okay?
画本的最后一页，我一直空着。对吧对吧，你猜我要画什么？: I've kept the last page of my sketchbook empty. Guess what I'm drawing! Go on, guess!
灯塔亮起来的那一刻！还有站在灯塔底下的你。: The moment the lighthouse lights up! And you, standing right under it.
画好了！送你一张，还有这瓶我攒了好久的极品灯露。不许不要！: Done! One copy's for you, plus this Superior Dew I saved forever. No saying no!
新来的守岛人？脚上别带泥进磨坊。: New Islekeeper? Don't track mud into my mill.
来了就坐。茶在壶里，自己倒。: Sit, now you're here. Tea's in the pot. Help yourself.
今儿个磨顺，你来得是时候。嗯。: Mill's running smooth today. Good timing. Mm.
你来了，葵盘都转过脸去看你。比看我还勤。: You walk in and Sunplate turns to look at you. More than it ever looks at me.
等你半天了。……没等，正好歇着。嗯。: Been waiting ages. ...Wasn't waiting. Just resting. Mm.
回吧。老话说，天黑不过桥。: Off you go. Old saying: don't cross bridges after dark.
回吧。明儿个新面下来，给你留一碗。: Off you go. I'll save you a bowl from tomorrow's fresh flour.
路上看着点，别逞能。嗯。: Watch the road. Don't show off. Mm.
磨面跟过日子一个理，快不得。嗯。: Milling's like living. Can't be rushed. Mm.
老磨坊这块地，风正，水近。选得好。: Good spot, Old Mill Isle. Steady wind, water close. Picked well.
阿禾那丫头的麦子，磨出来的面最白。别跟她说。: Ah He's wheat grinds the whitest flour. Don't tell her I said so.
小葵又来画我的磨。画了十几张，没一张像的。嗯。: Little Kui drew my mill again. Over a dozen tries, not one looks like it. Mm.
有时候半夜听见磨在响，起来一看，没动。是我老了。: Some nights I hear the mill turning. I get up, and it's still. I'm just getting old.
我年轻那会儿，一天能推三百圈磨。现在？三十圈就喘。: When I was young, I pushed that mill three hundred turns a day. Now? Thirty and I'm winded.
晴天葵盘最精神，脸一直跟着太阳转。: Sunplate's liveliest on sunny days. Its face follows the sun all day.
这样的太阳，旧大地上也有。一模一样。: The Old Land had sun just like this. Exactly like this.
下雨，收麦。别站着。: Rain. Bring the wheat in. Don't just stand there.
老话说，雨天磨刀，晴天割草。我今儿修磨。: Old saying: sharpen blades in rain, cut grass in sun. Today I fix the mill.
雨声跟磨声有点像。听着睡得踏实。嗯。: Rain sounds a bit like the mill. Helps me sleep. Mm.
岚那孩子准又飞出去了。阿禾又要念叨一整天。: Lan's off flying again, I bet. Ah He will fret about it all day.
风大的日子，我老想给磨坊装个风车。又舍不得拆磨架。: Windy days, I think about putting a windmill on the mill. Can't bear to take the frame apart, though.
雷天面粉受潮，结块。白瞎一袋。嗯。: Thunder days, the flour gets damp and clumps. Whole sack wasted. Mm.
旧大地沉的那天，也打这么响的雷。我不怕，就是记得。: Thunder this loud the day the Old Land sank. I'm not scared. I just remember.
起雾了。别往雾隐谷那边去。: Fog's rolling in. Stay away from Misthide Hollow.
我家烟团雾天最欢，钻进面袋里就不出来。嗯。: My Hazepuff loves fog. Burrows into the flour sacks and won't come out. Mm.
雾再大，磨坊的灯我不灭。你迷了路，就往亮处走。: However thick the fog, I keep the mill's lamp lit. If you get lost, walk toward the light.
这么晚了。有事说事。: It's late. Say what you came to say.
夜里凉，喝口热的再走。嗯。: Night's cold. Have something warm before you go. Mm.
睡不着？我也是。坐这儿，听磨坊吱呀，一会儿就困了。: Can't sleep? Me neither. Sit. Listen to the mill creak. You'll nod off soon.
你倒是懂行。这正是我缺的。: You know your stuff. This is just what I was missing.
你这孩子，比我那几个徒弟都贴心。嗯，收下了。: You're more thoughtful than any of my apprentices ever were. Mm. I'll take it.
不错，搁那儿吧。回头修磨架用。: Not bad. Leave it there. I'll use it on the mill frame.
老话说，礼轻情意重。你这礼也不轻。嗯。: Old saying: it's the thought that counts. This one's not a small thought either. Mm.
给我的？嗯，放下吧。: For me? Mm. Set it down.
这东西我用不太着，不过总有地方搁。: Not much use to me, but there's always somewhere to put it.
你来就行了，带啥东西。嗯。: You coming's enough. No need for gifts. Mm.
甜腻腻的，我牙不好。你拿回去吧。: Too sweet. My teeth can't take it. Take it back.
这个……给小葵吧，她爱吃。: This... give it to Little Kui. She likes it.
你明知道我不吃这个。逗我呢？嗯。: You know I don't eat this. Pulling my leg? Mm.
比划比划？行。别哭鼻子。: A little sparring? Fine. Don't go crying.
葵盘闲了好几天，正好让它活动筋骨。嗯。: Sunplate's been idle for days. Good chance to stretch its legs. Mm.
来，让老头子看看你这阵子长进了多少。: Come on. Let this old man see how much you've grown.
老话说，磨不转，是劲没使匀。你那几只也一样。: Old saying: if the mill won't turn, your push is uneven. Same with your spirits.
赢是赢了，可我这把老骨头也快散架了。你进步不小。: I won, but these old bones nearly fell apart. You've come a long way.
……输了。嗯，你有两下子。: ...I lost. Mm. You've got some skill.
输得服气。你那手换人，换得跟磨盘一样稳。: A fair loss. Your switches were steady as a millstone.
好，好！我这辈子没白活，还能见着这么好的守岛人。: Good, good! My life wasn't wasted if I got to see an Islekeeper this fine.
磨架要换料。你有多的，送来。不白要。: Mill frame needs new material. If you've got spare, bring it. I'll pay.
缺点东西，你帮老头子跑一趟。嗯。: I'm short on something. Run an errand for an old man. Mm.
这活儿只放心交给你。别人来，我还不乐意。: I'd only trust you with this. Anyone else, I wouldn't bother.
东西对了。这是工钱。: That's the right stuff. Here's your pay.
办得利索。嗯，没看错人。: Neatly done. Mm. I picked the right person.
多给你点，别推。老话说，好帮手比好磨难找。: Here's extra. Don't argue. Old saying: a good helper's harder to find than a good mill.
路过。看看。嗯。: Passing by. Taking a look. Mm.
你这田垄歪了。下回拉根绳子再种。: Your rows are crooked. Next time, stretch a string before planting.
你这岛越来越有人气了。我站这儿，像回到了村口。: Your isle's getting lively. Standing here feels like being back at the village gate.
老磨坊。磨是旧大地上带来的。别的没啥好看。: The old mill. The stone came from the Old Land. Nothing else worth seeing.
那面墙上挂的筛子，一个比一个细。最细的筛出来的面能当粉扑。: Those sieves on the wall get finer and finer. Flour from the finest could pass for face powder.
这岛是我的家，磨是我的根。往后你也算半个家里人。嗯。: This isle is my home, and the mill is my roots. From now on, you're half family. Mm.
诶诶，你就是新来的守岛人？我能画你吗？: Ooh, ooh, are you the new Islekeeper? Can I draw you?
你好你好！别动，我先记一下你今天的衣服颜色。: Hi, hi! Don't move, I'm writing down the colors you're wearing today.
“灯塔大人”来啦！……这是我给你起的外号，好听吧？: Sir Lighthouse is here! ...That's my nickname for you. Pretty good, huh?
你来得正好，我刚画完一只鸢絮，你帮我看看像不像！: Perfect timing! I just drew a Kitefluff. Does it look right?
我就知道你今天会来！我连你的位置都留好了。: I knew you'd come today! I even saved you a seat.
诶诶诶！你再晚来一会儿，我就要画一张“寻人启事”了！: Ooh, ooh! Any later and I'd have drawn a 'Missing Islekeeper' poster!
拜拜！下次让我画你家的絮灵哦。: Bye-bye! Next time, let me draw your spirits, okay?
要走啦？那我把今天画进本子里，就当你还在。: Leaving already? I'll draw today in my book, so it's like you're still here.
明天也要来！不来我就画你的鬼脸贴满晴原！: Come again tomorrow! Or I'll stick silly-face drawings of you all over the Sun Plains!
路上小心哦。你是我本子里最重要的一页。: Be careful out there. You're the most important page in my book.
你知道吗？暖芽打哈欠的时候，叶子会卷起来。可爱吧？: Did you know? When a Warmbud yawns, its leaves curl up. Cute, right?
向日岭的太阳落得最晚，画画光线最好！: The sun sets latest on Sunward Ridge. Best light for drawing!
老方说我画的磨盘像大饼。对吧对吧，是不是有点像？: Old Fang says my millstone looks like a big pancake. It kinda does, right? Right?
岚姐答应带我坐云舟去高处画全景，可她每次都飞太快！: Lan promised to take me up in her skiff to draw the view, but she always flies too fast!
我没见过旧大地。大家说起来都好想它，我就有点想画它。: I never saw the Old Land. Everyone misses it so much, it makes me want to draw it.
偷偷告诉你，我本子里画你的那页，比画絮灵的都多。: Secret: I have more pages of you in my book than of spirits.
大太阳！葵籽都把脑袋抬起来了，快看快看！: Big sunshine! The Sunseeds are all lifting their heads, look, look!
晴天的影子特别清楚，我要画一排絮灵的影子。: Shadows are so crisp on sunny days. I'm drawing a whole row of spirit shadows.
这么好的天，我们去麦浪坡写生吧？我给你带颜料！: Such a nice day! Wanna go sketch at Wheatwave Slope? I'll bring you paints!
下雨啦，颜料都晕开了……呜。: It's raining, and my paints are all running... Waah.
诶诶，雨天的檐滴会叮叮当当地唱歌，你听！: Ooh, ooh, Eavedrops go ding-dong-ding in the rain! Listen!
我们就在屋檐底下躲雨吧，我画你，你画我，不许偷看！: Let's wait out the rain under the eaves. I'll draw you, you draw me. No peeking!
哇，风好大！我的画纸要飞走啦！: Whoa, so windy! My paper's gonna blow away!
我家鸢絮最喜欢起风，它一飞我就追，追到喘不过气。: My Kitefluff loves the wind. When it takes off I chase it till I'm out of breath.
要是我也能像风一样就好了，一下子把整个云海都看完。: I wish I could be like the wind and see the whole Cloudsea all at once.
打、打雷了！我、我才不怕呢……: Th-thunder! I-I'm not scared or anything...
炉星在雷天会冒火花诶，我想画，但不敢靠近。: Forgesparks throw sparks when it thunders. I wanna draw them, but I'm scared to get close.
打雷的时候能不能……站我旁边一下？就一下。: While it's thundering, could you... stand next to me? Just for a bit.
起雾了，什么都看不清，画不了……: It's foggy. I can't see anything, so I can't draw...
雾里的烟团只露出两只眼睛，像在跟我玩捉迷藏。: Hazepuffs in the fog only show their eyes. Like they're playing hide-and-seek with me.
我讨厌蚀雾。可是普通的雾，其实也挺温柔的，对吧？: I hate the Blight. But regular fog is actually kind of gentle, right?
这么晚还在外面？小心别踩到睡着的絮灵哦。: Out this late? Careful not to step on any sleeping spirits.
晚上我画星星。每颗星星我都给它起了名字。: At night I draw stars. I've given every one of them a name.
睡不着就来找我吧，我们一起数星星，数到谁先睡着为止。: Can't sleep? Come find me. We'll count stars till one of us dozes off.
哇啊——这个！你怎么知道我最喜欢这个！: Waaah, this! How did you know it's my favorite?!
诶诶诶！我要把它画下来，然后再吃掉！: Ooh, ooh, ooh! I'm gonna draw it first, then eat it!
你是全云海最懂我的人！这页我要画金边的！: You get me better than anyone in the Cloudsea! This page gets a gold border!
谢谢！颜色真好看。: Thank you! What a pretty color.
好耶，正好能当颜料的样本！: Yay, this'll make a perfect paint sample!
你送的东西我都收在一个小盒子里，现在快装满啦。: I keep everything you give me in a little box. It's almost full now!
诶？给我的？谢谢……这是什么呀？: Huh? For me? Thanks... What is it?
嗯……我先放着，说不定哪天能画进去。: Hmm... I'll hang on to it. Maybe it'll end up in a drawing someday.
只要是你送的，我就给它起个外号收起来！: Anything from you gets a nickname and goes in my collection!
这个……灰扑扑的，不好画……: This is... kinda dusty and gray. Hard to draw...
诶，又硬又沉，老方可能会喜欢，我不太要……: Eh, it's hard and heavy. Old Fang might like it. I'll pass...
你是不是故意的！哼，我要在画里给你画两撇胡子。: You did that on purpose! Hmph, I'm drawing a mustache on you.
要、要比一场吗？我会认真的！: A-a battle? I'll take it seriously!
诶诶，比一场吧！我想近距离画你家絮灵出招的样子。: Ooh, ooh, let's battle! I wanna draw your spirits' moves up close.
这次我研究过你的套路了，画了满满三页！来吧！: I studied your moves this time. Three whole pages of notes! Bring it!
赢、赢了？真的吗？我要记下来！: I w-won? Really? I'm writing this down!
耶！“小馒头”今天超厉害的，对吧对吧！: Yay! Little Bun was amazing today, right? Right?
嘿嘿，我赢啦。不过你最后那一下，我画进本子里当封面。: Hehe, I won. But that last move of yours is going on my cover.
呜……输了。不过你的絮灵好帅，我能画它吗？: Waah... I lost. But your spirit's so cool. Can I draw it?
又输了！你怎么这么厉害，我要把你画成大怪兽！: Lost again! How are you so strong? I'm drawing you as a big monster!
输给你我不难过。……好吧有一点点。下次我会赢的！: I'm not sad I lost to you. ...Okay, a teeny bit. I'll win next time!
那个……能帮我找点东西吗？我想调一种新颜色。: Um... could you help me find something? I want to mix a new color.
诶诶，帮我个忙嘛！找到了我给你画一张肖像！: Ooh, ooh, help me out! Find it and I'll draw your portrait!
这件事只有“灯塔大人”能办到！拜托拜托！: Only Sir Lighthouse can do this! Pretty please!
谢谢你！这是谢礼，请收下。: Thank you! Here's a little something. Please take it.
就是这个颜色！你太棒啦，我要转三圈！: That's the color! You're the best! I'm gonna spin around three times!
谢谢你！给，谢礼——还有一张画，画的是你哦。: Thank you! Here's your reward, and a drawing too. It's of you!
打扰啦！我能在你家岛上画画吗？就一会儿！: Sorry to barge in! Can I draw on your isle? Just for a bit!
诶诶，你家多了好多东西！我要重新画一张了！: Ooh, ooh, you've added so much! I'll have to draw it all over again!
我又来啦！我已经能闭着眼睛画出你家的样子了。: I'm back! I could draw your isle with my eyes closed by now.
这是向日岭！整座岛都朝着太阳，葵籽可喜欢这儿了。: This is Sunward Ridge! The whole isle faces the sun. Sunseeds love it here.
那棵歪脖子树下面是我的画架。别碰哦，颜料还没干。: My easel's under that crooked tree. Don't touch, the paint's still wet.
以前这岛光秃秃的，是我和葵籽一棵一棵种出这片花的。: This isle used to be bare. Sunseed and I planted all these flowers, one by one.
说话慢，爱用“咱们”，常提起以前的麦田；句子短，带一点乡音。: Speaks slowly and says 'we' and 'us' a lot; often recalls the old wheat fields. Short sentences with a bit of country accent.
在云海上种出一片能办丰收节的麦田。: Grow a wheat field on the Cloudsea big enough to hold a harvest festival.
这是咱们岛上磨出来的第一袋面粉。你尝尝，还是那个味儿。: This is the first sack of flour milled on our isles. Have a taste. Same as it used to be.
以前村里每年秋天都蒸馒头，整条街都是麦香。: Every autumn back in the village, we'd steam buns. The whole street smelled of wheat.
你家岛上要是添几只小絮灵，就得有个繁殖屋。图纸我这儿有，拿去吧。: If you want little spirits on your isle, you'll need a Hatchery. I've got a blueprint. Take it.
岚那孩子说，要给我做一架全晴原最高的风车。: Lan says she's gonna build me the tallest windmill in all the Sun Plains.
她小时候总爬到我家风车顶上看云，摔下来好几回也不怕。: As a kid she'd climb my windmill to watch the clouds. Fell off plenty. Never scared her.
这几瓶精制灯露你收着。遇到稀罕的絮灵，用得上。: Keep this Refined Dew. It'll come in handy when you meet a rare spirit.
麦子熟了。咱们说好的，办一场丰收节。: The wheat's ripe. Like we promised, let's hold a harvest festival.
我想把晴原的守岛人都请来，还有你，还有你家那些小家伙。: I want every Islekeeper in the Sun Plains there. You too, and all your little ones.
温泉的图纸给你。累了一年，大家都该泡一泡。: Here's a Hot Spring blueprint. After a long year, everyone deserves a soak.
语速快，爱用短句和反问，喜欢下战书；不服输，但输了会认真夸对方。: Talks fast in short lines and rhetorical questions, loves throwing down challenges; hates losing, but sincerely praises whoever beats her.
驾着云舟飞到云海的尽头，看看那边有什么。: Fly her skiff to the edge of the Cloudsea and see what's out there.
你就是新来的守岛人？……还行吧，比我想的靠谱一点。: So you're the new Islekeeper? ...Not bad. A bit more solid than I thought.
雾隐谷那边的蚀雾越来越多了。抓到蚀化的絮灵别丢下，带回去净化。: The Blight's spreading in Misthide Hollow. Catch a Blighted spirit? Don't leave it. Bring it back and purify it.
净化池的图纸，拿着。别谢我，下次跟我比一场就行。: Purifying Pool blueprint. Take it. Don't thank me, just battle me next time.
小时候我放过一只风筝，线断了，它一直往云海那边飞。: When I was little I flew a kite. The string snapped, and it kept flying out over the Cloudsea.
我追到岛边上，差点掉下去，是阿禾姐把我拽回来的。: I chased it to the edge of the isle and nearly fell. Ah He pulled me back.
从那以后我就想，总有一天要追上它。……这本书送你，我已经背熟了。: Ever since, I've wanted to catch up to it someday. ...Take this book. I know it by heart.
灯塔亮了以后，风谷那边的雾也会散吧。: Now the lighthouse is lit, the fog over Wind Valley should clear too, right?
到时候我第一个过去。你要来的话……我等你。: I'm going first. If you're coming... I'll wait for you.
这瓶极品灯露是我攒了很久的。给你了，别浪费。: Saved this Superior Dew a long time. It's yours. Don't waste it.
哟，来啦。路上风大不大？: Oh, you're here. Was it windy on the way?
是新来的守岛人吧？咱们离得近，常来坐坐。: You're the new Islekeeper, right? We're neighbors. Drop by often.
来得正好，锅里刚蒸上包子。: Good timing. I just put buns in the steamer.
看你脸色，又熬夜了吧？先坐下歇歇。: You look tired. Up late again? Sit and rest a bit.
你一来，我这岛上的絮灵都跑出来迎你。: Whenever you come, all the spirits on my isle run out to greet you.
拿两个包子路上吃。……拿着，别客气。: Take a couple of buns for the road. ...Go on, take them.
麦子这东西，急不得。你对它好，它就对你好。: Wheat can't be rushed. Treat it well, and it treats you well.
以前村口有棵老槐树，夏天大家都在底下乘凉。: There was an old locust tree at the village gate. In summer, everyone sat in its shade.
暖芽最爱趴在田埂上晒太阳，叫都叫不走。: Warmbuds love lying on the field ridges in the sun. Can't call them away.
岚那孩子又去雾隐谷了，说了多少回也不听。: Lan's gone to Misthide Hollow again. I've told her so many times.
有时候我做梦，梦见脚底下踩着的是真的土地。: Sometimes I dream there's real earth under my feet.
今天太阳好，晒麦子的好天气。: Lovely sun today. Good weather for drying wheat.
晴天的时候，暖芽走路都蹦着。: On sunny days, Warmbuds bounce when they walk.
下雨了，田里的雨莓该长个儿了。: It's raining. The Rainberries in the field will grow nicely.
雨天别乱跑，檐滴会把你淋透的。: Don't run around in the rain. The Eavedrops will soak you through.
风这么大，岚肯定又出去飞了。: With wind like this, Lan's surely out flying again.
打雷了……夜里那些炉星会出来，小心点。: Thunder... The Forgesparks will be out tonight. Be careful.
起雾了。雾大的时候别往远处走。: Fog's coming in. Don't wander far when it's thick.
这么晚还在外头？夜里的絮灵不太一样，看着点。: Still out this late? Spirits are different at night. Watch yourself.
夜里的云海安静，像一大锅刚熬好的粥。: The Cloudsea's so quiet at night. Like a big pot of fresh porridge.
哎呀，这个我最喜欢了！你怎么知道的？: Oh my, this is my favorite! How did you know?
你这孩子，有心了。我收下啦。: Oh, you sweet thing. How thoughtful. I'll take it.
谢谢，正好用得上。: Thank you, I can use this.
好东西，我拿去做点吃的，回头分你。: Good stuff. I'll cook something with it and share some with you.
给我的？那我收下了，谢谢。: For me? Then I'll take it. Thank you.
这个……我用不太上。不过心意我领了。: This... I can't really use it. But I appreciate the thought.
比一场？好啊，让咱家暖芽活动活动。: A battle? Sure, my Warmbud could use the exercise.
哈哈，承让承让。你家絮灵也很不错。: Haha, you went easy on me. Your spirits are lovely too.
输了输了。你带得真好，它们都很信你。: I lost, I lost. You've raised them so well. They really trust you.
我这儿缺点东西，你要是有多的，帮我凑凑？: I'm short on a few things. If you have extra, could you help me out?
帮大忙了！这是谢礼，别推。: That's a big help! Here's a thank-you. Don't refuse it.
路过你家，顺道来看看。田里的东西长得挺好嘛。: I was passing by, so I stopped in. Your crops are coming along nicely.
你这岛越来越像样了，比我刚来那会儿强多了。: Your isle's really shaping up. Much better than mine when I first came.
我这片麦田种了好几年了，一开始也只有巴掌大。: I've tended this wheat field for years. It started out no bigger than my palm.
那架小风车是岚帮我搭的，转起来吱吱响。: Lan helped me build that little windmill. It squeaks when it turns.
来了？正好，我刚发现一条新航线。: Here? Good. I just found a new route.
你来得真慢。……我是说，等你半天了。: You're slow. ...I mean, I've been waiting forever.
下次别让我等太久。: Don't keep me waiting next time.
路上要是碰见蚀化的絮灵，记得叫我。: If you run into a Blighted spirit out there, call me.
云舟最快能有多快？我想试试。: How fast can a skiff really go? I wanna find out.
鸢絮小时候连风都怕，现在比我还野。: My Kitefluff used to be scared of wind. Now it's wilder than me.
阿禾姐又让我少往雾隐谷跑。我才不听。: Ah He told me to stay out of Misthide Hollow again. Like I'd listen.
你说云海下面……会不会也有人在往上看？: You think someone under the Cloudsea is looking up too?
其实我挺怕高的。别告诉别人。: Truth is, I'm kinda scared of heights. Don't tell anyone.
下雨了，云舟的核心受潮，飞不起来，烦。: Rain. Skiff's core gets damp and won't fly. Ugh.
起风了！就是今天！: Wind's picking up! Today's the day!
这风正好，我能一口气飞到溪石屿。: Perfect wind. I could fly to Brookstone Isle in one go.
雷天的炉星特别凶，抓一只回来当搭档挺好。: Forgesparks get fierce in thunder. Catching one as a partner would be great.
雾这么大，提灯得点亮一点。: Fog this thick, better turn your lantern up.
夜里出来的絮灵我都认识，不信你问。: I know every spirit that comes out at night. Go on, test me.
睡不着就出来看星星。你也是吧？: Can't sleep, so I came out to see the stars. You too?
这个！你从哪儿弄来的？……咳，谢了。: This! Where'd you get it? ...Ahem. Thanks.
给我？行吧，收下了。: For me? Fine, I'll take it.
敢不敢跟我比一场？输了可别哭。: Dare to battle me? Don't cry when you lose.
就这？再练练吧。: That's it? Go train some more.
赢了。不过你那只絮灵挺有意思的。: I win. That spirit of yours is pretty interesting, though.
……你很强。下次我不会输的。: ...You're strong. I won't lose next time.
输了就是输了。你那一招换人，换得真漂亮。: A loss is a loss. That switch of yours was beautiful.
帮我弄点东西，我修云舟要用。给钱的。: Get me some stuff for skiff repairs. I'll pay.
谢了，这下能飞更远了。: Thanks. Now I can fly even farther.
路过。……真的只是路过。: Just passing by. ...Really, just passing by.
你家风小，云舟停这儿正合适。我歇会儿。: Your isle's not too windy. Good spot to park a skiff. I'll rest a bit.
风铃都是我捡来的，每一个响声都不一样。: I found all these wind chimes myself. Each one rings differently.
岛小，但风好。这就够了。: Small isle, but great wind. That's enough.
